# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 23 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_023_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 23

**23:1** Now at the time of the morning offering, the priests were standing waiting for Zechariah to greet them with a blessing as was his custom, and he was long delayed. And one of the priests had the courage to go in and saw beside the altar of the Lord congealed blood; and a voice said, "Zechariah has been slain and his blood shall not be wiped away until his avenger comes."

**23:2** And when he heard these words, he was afraid and went out and told the priests what he had seen and heard. And they had the courage to go in and saw what had happened. And the wainscotings of the temple cried out, and they rent their garments from the top to the bottom.

**23:3** And they found not his body, but they found his blood turned to stone. And they were afraid and went out and told the people that Zechariah had been slain. And all the tribes of the people heard it and mourned him and lamented him three days and three nights.

**23:4** And after three days the priests took counsel as to whom they should appoint in his place. And the lot fell to Simeon. For it was he to whom it had been revealed by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death until he had seen the Christ in the flesh.
